RothenhauslerEtAl2015BackShift, Corollary 2(ii), covers fully continuous amplitudes; PerryVonKugelgenScholkopf2022SparseShift studies sparse mechanism changes in a distinct DAG/MSS model, not affine occupancy under whole-slot replacement.
LeNguyen2022HermitianSDC supplies congruence-diagonalization feasibility machinery; the proposed binomial subset enumeration is explicitly only an oracle wrapper and does not itself advance it.
RothenhauslerEtAl2015BackShift, Theorem 1, gives the same c=0 necessary-and-sufficient BACKSHIFT uniqueness criterion; the affine-cloud wording is its baseline-invariant re-expression.

AndrewsCheng2013SporadicID motivates identification-robust confidence sets, but does not give this corrupted-BACKSHIFT inversion; the displayed coverage argument is nevertheless a direct outer-union construction.

Afsari2008JDSensitivity treats local selected-family sensitivity and AndrewsCheng2013SporadicID treats general sporadic identification; neither supplies rational affine-minor certificates or subset-uniform BACKSHIFT inference.

novelty_flags.label: prop:backshift-reduction
novelty_flags.one_line: This is expressly a non-novel baseline-invariant restatement of RothenhauslerEtAl2015BackShift Theorem 1 and should be a sanity note rather than a root solve target.

soundness_flags.label: ass:invariant-noise-psd
soundness_flags.one_line: The global PSD-noise condition is strictly implied by ass:invariant-noise-interior and is not present in any statement dependency list despite its used_by metadata; remove it or use it in a genuinely PSD-only result.

soundness_flags.label: prop:subset-oracle-corollary
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed equality is stated to hold “by definition” and the binomial query count is only enumeration, so this root proposition has no substantive mathematical content.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:sharp-replacement-radius / ass:invariant-noise-interior
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The matching positive-definite contamination converse is claimed only when the invariant nuisance is interior, Ω ∈ S_{++}^p.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The replacement-radius iff is sharp conditional on the interior-noise regime; no PSD-boundary converse is claimed.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: prop:subset-oracle-corollary
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: SubsetConsensus presupposes a full-solution feasibility oracle and is not a terminating certified solver.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Any computational claim is oracle-relative only; implementable certification remains the open-ended question.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 states unique BACKSHIFT solution iff every variable pair has two environments whose intervention-variance profiles satisfy the non-collinearity determinant condition; it also states the nonzero-variance ratio formulation.

source_verification_receipts.version: author manuscript corresponding to IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing 61(7), 2013
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The theorem gives essential uniqueness of a complete exact non-unitary joint-diagonalization family iff its diagonal-profile collinearity modulus is below one.
The article introduces a threshold for identifying outlier target matrices and alternating minimization; it explicitly reports no convergence proof for the outlier-aware method.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 4, Corollary 4.2; p. 6, Theorem 5.3 and Corollary 5.4
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proves bivariate identifiability under one sparse causal-mechanism change and high-probability MSS graph recovery as the number of environments grows; its object is not BACKSHIFT covariance congruence.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv preprint 2007.14034 corresponding to SIAM J. Matrix Anal. Appl. 43(2), 2022
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work gives equivalent Hermitian simultaneous-diagonalization-via-congruence conditions and a numerical method combining a PSD program with a Jacobi-like stage.

source_verification_receipts.version: public author PDF corresponding to SIAM J. Matrix Anal. Appl. 30(3), 2008
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies exact joint-diagonalizer uniqueness and sensitivity, with conditioning and a modulus of uniqueness affecting local perturbation behavior.
The article studies estimators, tests, and confidence sets when parameters are unidentified on parts of the parameter space, rather than corrupted-BACKSHIFT subset inversion.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Delete ass:invariant-noise-psd or add a distinct PSD-only theorem; retain the interior condition only where the sharp converse genuinely needs it.

Move prop:backshift-reduction to a sanity-reduction paragraph and prop:subset-oracle-corollary to a definition/implementation note, leaving the radius theorem and sparse-support formula as the root contribution targets.
Strengthen the paper by determining whether the sharp converse can be extended to semidefinite invariant noise, or explicitly characterize the boundary obstruction if it cannot.
Add an explicit optimal sparse-support design corollary with a construction and matching incidence lower bound for a fixed corruption budget.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two noncontributory root propositions and the redundant noise assumption, then advance the exact-radius and sparse-support kernels to Stage 0.
